title: Audition form: the incumbent (keep) option plays the scene continuously for 16 bars
description: In the first Listen-page cycle, the keep option's audition (audition_form.build_scene_audition: the scene's first 4 bars, the same 4 bars again, then the 8-bar window) sounded to the user like the scene layered on itself: 'This is weird: Did we select the same sample to layer on top of itself?'. The repeated restarts are audible. Make the incumbent's audition the scene playing continuously for 16 bars (render 16 bars of the scene around or ending at the window), level-matched with the candidates, so keep sounds like the song as it is. Keep the candidates' form (scene 4, part solo 4, both 8). Test: the keep audition has no discontinuity at bars 4 and 8.
